Cash Account Setup - Cash Allocation Tool - Version 9.0

Use the Cash
Allocation Tool.

After the updater is installed, this walks you through reading your account balances in NinjaTrader and using the Cash Algo Allocator to get the exact set file for each algo on each account. It also explains Stable / Set Sizing versus Compounding so you can choose. Complete it inside your VPS.

Two sizing modelsThe allocator offers two Sizing Models:
  • Stable / Set Sizing is the more conservative model: each algo trades a fixed set file size.
  • Compounding is the more aggressive model: each algo trades a percent share of the live account balance, so size moves with the account.
The choice is yours. See section 3 for how each one works before you open the allocator.
